SELECT t.id, t.title, t.status, t.display_order, t.category_id, t.assignee_id, t.start_date, t.due_date, t.parent_id, p.title AS parent_title, c.name AS category_name, c.color AS category_color, a.name AS assignee_name FROM todos t LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = t.category_id LEFT JOIN assignees a ON a.id = t.assignee_id LEFT JOIN todos p ON p.id = t.parent_id

SELECT t.id, t.title, t.status, t.display_order, t.category_id, t.assignee_id, t.start_date, t.due_date, t.parent_id, p.title AS parent_title, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM todos child WHERE child.parent_id = t.id) AS child_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM todos child WHERE child.parent_id = t.id AND child.status = 'COMPLETED') AS completed_child_count, c.name AS category_name, c.color AS category_color, a.name AS assignee_name FROM todos t LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = t.category_id LEFT JOIN assignees a ON a.id = t.assignee_id LEFT JOIN todos p ON p.id = t.parent_id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_tasks, COUNT(CASE WHEN t.status = 'NOT_STARTED' THEN 1 END) AS not_started_tasks, COUNT(CASE WHEN t.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 1 END) AS in_progress_tasks, COUNT(CASE WHEN t.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 END) AS completed_tasks, COUNT(CASE WHEN t.status != 'COMPLETED' AND t.due_date < #{today,jdbcType=DATE} THEN 1 END) AS overdue_tasks FROM todos t WHERE
WHERE AND t.status != 'COMPLETED' AND t.due_date BETWEEN #{today,jdbcType=DATE} AND #{lastDay,jdbcType=DATE} ORDER BY t.due_date, t.id

SELECT a.name AS group_name, COUNT(*) AS total_tasks, COUNT(CASE WHEN t.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 END) AS completed_tasks FROM todos t LEFT JOIN assignees a ON a.id = t.assignee_id WHERE GROUP BY a.id, a.name ORDER BY CASE WHEN a.id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, a.name, a.id

SELECT c.name AS group_name, COUNT(*) AS total_tasks, COUNT(CASE WHEN t.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 END) AS completed_tasks FROM todos t LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = t.category_id WHERE GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY CASE WHEN c.id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, c.name, c.id

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO todos (title, status, display_order, category_id, assignee_id, start_date, due_date, parent_id) VALUES (#{title}, #{status}, #{displayOrder}, #{categoryId}, #{assigneeId}, #{startDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{dueDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{parentId,jdbcType=BIGINT})
mapper.update: UPDATE todos SET title = #{title}, status = #{status}, category_id = #{categoryId}, assignee_id = #{assigneeId}, start_date = #{startDate,jdbcType=DATE}, due_date = #{dueDate,jdbcType=DATE}, parent_id = #{parentId,jdbcType=BIGINT} WHERE id = #{id}
